test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 5 men and 8 women can complete a work in 12 days working together, while 3 men and 7 women together can complete the same work in 15 days. In how many days will 11 women complete the same work?
solution:
Given:

5 men and 8 women can complete a work in 12 days working together, while 3 men and 7 women together can complete the same work in 15 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency of each worker × Number of Hours × Number of days to finish × Number of total workers

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of each man and woman be M and W respectively.

​According to the question,

(5M + 8W) × 12 = (3M + 7W) × 15

⇒ 60M + 96W = 45M + 105W

⇒ 15M = 9W

⇒ M = 3W/5 ....(1)

Now, time taken to complete the work by 11 women 

⇒ (5M + 8W) × 12 ÷ 11W

⇒ (3W + 8W) × 12 ÷ 11W (From 1)

⇒ 12 days

**∴ 11 women will complete the same work in 12 days.**
